name: UW Control (counters + sweepers)
description: A generic Azorius control script: cantrips early, holds up countermagic from turn 2, sweeps the board on turn 4, resolves a card-advantage engine, wins late with a single protected finisher. Teaches playing around counters and sweepers, and threat sequencing.

turns.boardSummary: 2 lands untapped at end of turn (counter mana up)

events.note: They pass with mana up. Your two-drop is likely safe; your key engine piece is not. Bait with the lesser spell first.

turns.boardSummary: 3 lands; cantrip at your end step

events.note: Instant-speed card selection on your end step keeps counter mana open all turn.

All creatures die (CR 704.5g after damage, or destroy effect). Aristocrats lines: this is a *gift* if a death-trigger payoff is out — every creature dying at once is a burst of triggers (CR 603.10a: leaves-the-battlefield abilities look back in time).
From here they out-card you. Recursion (graveyard → battlefield) is how you rebuild faster than they can answer.
Clock: ~3 turns. Your line must win or neutralize this by turn 10.
